Subject: Mandatory online filing of returns by Exempted and Relaxed establishments.
Sir/Madam,
The Central Provident Fund Commissioner
in exercise of his powers conferred
by sub-paragraph
7 of Paragraph 36 read
with entry No.16 of Appendix-A to Paragraph 27M
of the Employees' Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952 made it mandatory
for all establishments
exempted
under Sub-Section (l)(a)
of
Section
17 or Sub-Section
(2)
of
Section
17 of the
Employees'
Provident
Funds & Miscellaneous
Provisions Act, 1952 read
with Paragraph 27A of Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 or granted
relaxation
under Paragraph 79 of the Employees' Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952 to file their monthly
and annual returns online in the prescribed proforma.
2.
Further,
establishments
which
have
been
granted
exemption
by an order
of the
Regional
Provident
Fund Commissioner
for individual
employees
under the provisions
of Paragraph
27 of the
Employees'
Provident
Funds Scheme,
1952 shall also file
their
monthly
and annual
returns
in the
prescribed proforma online.
3.
In addition
to online
submission
of returns,
exempted
and relaxed
establishments
shall also
submit duly authenticated
copy of the returns
in hard copy till such time the facility
for filing digitally
signed return is provided.
Once the data is entered and saved by the establishment
in various parts, a
PDF is generated. This can be printed, signed with seal and submitted
by the employer.
4.
The instructions
issued earlier vide Head Office circular No. C/Misc./Ex-Return/2013/27552
dated
27.03.2014
to the effect that the annual return for the year 2013-14 will also be filed alongwith
the
monthly
return from 01.04.2014
(March,
2014 paid in April, 2014) stands modified.
Presently, all the
Exempted and Relaxed establishments
will only file monthly return online from 01.04.2014.
Page 1 of 2

5.
In case of any confusion, Additional CPFC (IS) may be contacted for technical issues and
Additional CPFC(Compliance) may be contacted for businessissues.
6.
A copy of the said order along with the return format are enclosed herewith. It should be given
wide publicity and brought to the notice of all Exempted and Relaxed establishments under your
jurisdiction for strict compliance.
Enclosures:As above
Yours faithfully,
Addl. Central PF Commissioner (Compliance)

ORDER
In exercise of powers conferred
by sub-paragraph
7 of Paragraph 36 read
with entry No.16 of Appendix-
A to Paragraph 27AA of the Employees'
Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952, I, K.KJalan,
the Central Provident
Fund
Commissioner hereby direct all establishments
exempted
under Sub-Section (l)(a)
of Section 17 or Sub-Section (2)
of
Section 17 of the Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 read
with Paragraph 27A of
Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 or granted
relaxation
under Paragraph 79 of the Employees' Provident
Funds Scheme, 1952 to file their monthly
and annual returns online in the proforma
attached
herewith
(The said
proforma is also available in the official web site of Employees Provident Fund Organisation
- www.epfindia.gov.in
/ www.epfindia.com
). The returns shall be filed with effect from
April, 2014(March,2014
paid in April,2014).
The
proforma contains the following
parts:

Details

Details

Details

The
provisrons
of
online
filing
of
returns
in
the
prescribed
proforma
shall
also
be
applicable
to
establishments
which have been granted
exemption
by an order of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner
for
individual employees under the provisions of Paragraph 27 of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952.
3.
Further details for online filing of monthly
and annual
return
has been provided
on the website
of the
Employees' Provident Fund Organization
at the following
URL:
www.epfindia.gov.in
www.epfindia.com
4.

to online submission
of returns,
exempted
and relaxed establishments
shall also submit
duly
authenticated
copy of the returns in hard copy till such time the facility for filing digitally signed return is provided.
